image_description: A cooked Dungeness crab presented on a white plate. The crab exhibits a reddish-orange carapace with some greenish discoloration, likely from cooking or algae. It has large, robust claws (chelipeds) and visible walking legs tucked underneath or extending to the sides. The texture appears hard and calcified.
